+    def _valid_time_stamp(self, time_stamp):
+        ''' Return a valid ZIP timestamp tuple, or the ZIP epoch for invalid timestamps. '''
+        epoch = (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
+        if not isinstance(time_stamp, str):

+
+        match = re.fullmatch(r'(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})\.(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})', time_stamp)
+        if not match:
+            return epoch
+
+        year, month, day, hour, minute, second = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
+        if not 1980 <= year <= 2107:
+            return epoch
+
+        if not 1 <= month <= 12 or not 0 <= hour <= 23 or not 0 <= minute <= 59 or not 0 <= second <= 59:
+            return epoch
+
+        days_in_month = (31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31)
+        is_leap_year = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
+        max_day = days_in_month[month - 1] + (1 if month == 2 and is_leap_year else 0)
+        if not 1 <= day <= max_day:
+            return epoch
+
+        return (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, 0, 0, 0)
